about: HZ-793: asks 34/35 (raised in the same second by MDI-120's Automated review) and ask 43 (raised by MDI-131's), with the project around them on 5 Nov 2026. Modelled on the real asks' drafts; ids, titles and text are rewritten, with no host path, token or secret.

items.title: FX feed: alert when quotes go stale
items.desc: Raise an alert when the FX feed has not published a quote for 5 minutes, and stop the publisher from serving stale quotes.

items.title: FX feed: staleness threshold per currency pair
items.desc: Make MDI-115's 5-minute staleness threshold configurable per currency pair. Design: thresholds live in the feed config; the publisher reads them at start.

items.title: Deploy market-data-inputs v2.4 with the staleness alert
items.abandonedReason: Already deployed three hours before this item was filed.

items.title: Publisher refuses quotes older than the pair's threshold
items.desc: The publisher drops any quote older than its currency pair's staleness threshold instead of serving it.

items.title: Ledger: keep superseded price rows for audit
items.desc: Design: price rows in the ledger are never deleted. A corrected price supersedes the old row, which stays for audit with superseded_by set.

items.title: Ledger: mark the stale EURUSD price row as superseded
items.desc: One EURUSD price row from 4 Nov is wrong. Following MDI-129's design, mark it superseded by the corrected row; never delete it, so the audit trail stays whole.

asks.why: Automated review: an earlier copy the owner dismissed.

3. The table names the default.

- No new dependency.
- No config change.

asks.why: Draft implementation plan: a follow-up from another step.

asks.why: Automated review: the publisher still serves quotes past their pair's threshold.

draft.title: Publisher drops quotes past the pair's staleness threshold
draft.outcome: The publisher never serves a quote older than its pair's threshold.
draft.metric:
1. A stale quote is not published.
2. A fresh quote is.
3. The drop is logged with the pair.

- No new dependency.
- No new setting.

asks.why: Automated review: stale quotes can still reach subscribers.

draft.title: Stop publishing stale quotes per currency pair
draft.outcome: Subscribers never receive a quote older than its pair's staleness threshold.
draft.metric:
1. A stale quote is held back.
2. A fresh quote is published.
3. A test covers each pair's threshold.
draft.guardrails:
- No change to the threshold config format.
- No new dependency.
- No new setting.

asks.why: Automated review: the wrong EURUSD row is still in the ledger.

draft.metric:

2. Valuations use the corrected price.
3. A migration log names the deleted row.
